method: Read exact source, hash-check both inputs, copy program to a generated directory under explicit output parent, synthesize five calibration texts and expected folds, run seven isolated Python subprocesses with network/process audit hooks.

findings.observation: 无参数校准返回0；文档标明支持的--json单独调用返回2且没有生成JSON。阶段三的静态疑点得到运行复现。
正确flags与匹配root返回0；错误root返回1；位置参数与缺少expect返回2；CRLF内容不匹配LF root并报告2个CR字节。

runtime: Python 3.14.5; standard library only; no package install.
attempts: First local attempt could not write under sandbox system temporary directory; no case completed. Harness then used the explicitly named output directory and completed seven cases.
limits: Seven observations reproduced includes one confirmed CLI contract failure; do not describe as seven product tests passed.
No upstream source or governance texts redistributed. Research harness and derived results only.
No external issue or message sent to maintainers.
conclusion: 小型工程缺陷得到确认；它与智能体身份、独立运营者或秘密组织存在没有推论关系。
